from pycosat import solve

def three_sat(s):
    return solve(s)

# Example 3-SAT instance
example_3sat = [
    [1, 2, -3],
    [1, -2, 3],
    [-1, 2, -3],
    [-1, -2, 3],
    [1, -2, -3],
    [-1, 2, 3]
]

result = three_sat(example_3sat)
print(result)
